title: Roles of the Internal Coupling: From Equilibrium to Non-Equilibrium Dynamics
summary: We identify the precise thermodynamic roles of internal coupling in quantum thermal machines by analyzing the quantum Otto cycle across thermalized Gibbs-state limit cycles (GSLC) and finite-time non-equilibrating limit cycles (NELC). By systematically comparing the internally coupled system with standard and dressed-spectrum models, we resolve previous misconceptions regarding the physical origins of performance variations.
